home.title: Home
home.noOffice: No office assigned. Ask your admin.
home.loadFailed: Couldn't load your details. Pull down to try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to check in
signIn.invalidInput: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number and your password.
signIn.employeeForgot: Forgot your password? Ask your admin.

update.title: Update required
update.body: This version of Mukham ({{current}}) is no longer supported. Please install version {{required}} or newer.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.title: Your face data
consent.p1: We save one photo of your face to confirm it is you at sign-in and check-in.
consent.p2: It is stored privately and never shown to anyone.
consent.p3: It is deleted when you leave the organisation.

face.title: Look at the camera
face.hint: Hold the phone at eye level, in good light.
face.failed: The face check didn't pass. Please try again.
face.expired: Sign-in took too long. Please enter your password again.
face.permissionBody: Mukham needs the camera for the live face check.
face.unavailableTitle: Face check needs the Mukham app build
face.unavailableBody: The live face check uses native code that Expo Go and the browser don't include. Install the Mukham development build on this phone to sign in as an employee. Admins can sign in here.

register.title: Register your organisation
register.name: Organisation name
register.invalidInput: Enter the organisation name and a valid 10-digit mobile number.
register.doneBody: Sign in as Admin with mobile number {{mobile}} and this password. Write it down now; it is shown only once.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.body: Enter your organisation's email. We'll send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email, a reset link is on its way. Open it on any device to set a new password, then sign in here.

checkIn.outsideBody: You are {{distance}} from {{office}}. Move closer and try again.
checkIn.faceFailedBody: Hold the phone at eye level, in good light, and try again.
checkIn.permissionBody: Mukham needs your location to confirm you're at the office.
checkIn.permissionBlocked: Location access is turned off for Mukham. Turn it on in Settings, then try again.
checkIn.servicesOff: Location is turned off on this phone. Turn it on and try again.
checkIn.timeout: Couldn't get a GPS fix. Move near a window or outside, then try again.

states.offlineBody: Check your internet connection and try again.

attendance.today: Today: {{in}} in, {{out}} checked out, {{absent}} not in
attendance.noEmployees: No employees yet. Add them on the web, or in People (Phase 6).
attendance.confirmBody: This records the current time and marks it as added by admin.
attendance.manualNote: Uses the current time and is marked "Added by admin".

people.exportUnavailable: This version of the app can't share files. Install the latest Mukham app build, then try again.
people.empty: No employees yet. Tap Add to add the first one.

person.removeBody: They can no longer sign in. Anyone who reports to them moves up to their manager.
person.addedBody: {{name}} signs in with mobile number {{mobile}} and the password {{password}}. Pass it on now: it is shown only once. Their first sign-in saves their face.
person.passwordNote: After saving, you'll see their first password once, to pass on to them.

org.hint: Shows who reports to this person. Hold for more.

invalid.employee: Choose who the task is for.
invalid.title: Enter a title.
invalid.due: The due date can't be before the assigned date.

setup.noOffices: No offices yet. Add one so employees can check in.
setup.needOffice: Add an office first: every department belongs to one.
setup.deleteDepartmentBody: Only an empty department can be deleted: no employees, designations or shifts.
setup.assignBody: Everyone in {{department}} gets this shift, replacing their current one.
setup.deleteShiftBody_one: {{count}} person has this shift and will be left without one.
setup.deleteShiftBody_other: {{count}} people have this shift and will be left without one.
setup.noPlaces: No places found. Try another address, or tap the map.
setup.tapMap: Tap the map to place the office
setup.deleteOfficeBody: Only an office with no departments, employees or past check-ins can be deleted.
setup.emailNote: Password-reset emails go to this address.

invalid.name: Enter a name.
invalid.sameTimes: The start and end can't be the same time.
invalid.pin: Place the office on the map: search, tap the map or use your location.

setup.needDepartment: Add a department first: every designation belongs to one.
setup.designationsAfterSave: After saving, you can add this department's designations here or in Setup › Designations.

push.introShift: Shortly before your shift starts, if you haven't checked in
push.introCheckOut: If you forget to check out after your shift
push.introTask: When you're given a new task

push.switchCheckOut: If I forget to check out
